research.name: Polygonjs
research.note: Node-based 3D engine on three.js where geometry, shaders, materials and interactions are built as connected node graphs.

effects: 3D scene defined as node graphs split into contexts (SOP procedural modelling, GL shader, MAT, POST, ANIM, AUDIO, JS actor nodes)
actor node graph wiring hover events to object rotation and instrument notes

unverified: Only one static README screenshot was viewed (the editor at polygonjs.com/demo with a 3D viewport and a node graph); nothing was seen running.

The node editor in that screenshot is not in this repository: src/ holds only core, engine, modules and types, and the editor ships as the separate npm package polygonjs-editor, whose source and license were not checked.
The LICENSE file is MIT (commit 2023-10-16 'revert license to MIT'), but package.json still declares 'PolyForm Shield'; which one governs the published npm package was not confirmed.

The README says v1 is in maintenance mode and superseded by Polygon v2; polygonjs.com and its docs now describe Polygon 2.0.64, a paid product, so the homepage and live demo no longer show this repository's code.
requiresHostedService false is inferred from the README (npm install, local editor, direct three.js access), not from running it.
